repo_standards_ref: references/global-crew.md (match surrounding conventions; minimal change; fail visibly), references/global-everyone.md; src/physics/fingerprint/address.py + fit.py + join.py seam signatures. No docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md or GLOSSARY.md present in this worktree.

smells.finding: build_summary(~70 lines) is decomposed into short single-purpose helpers (_field_rows, _derive_vocabulary, _fit_all_drivers, _prior_record, _thin_surfacing, _honest_statement); no over-long body.
No classes defined; module-level functions only.
No meaningful duplication; the _key() helper already factors the shared (driver,circuit,channel) projection. Synthetic-vs-real test setup is distinct test data, not dup logic.
Helpers operate on the records/objects they own; reading prior.* on the returned WeekendUtilizationPrior is ordinary consumption of the join's return value.

OBSERVATION (non-blocking): the (driver, circuit, channel) triple recurs as _prior_record params and as record dict keys. Already partly mitigated by the _key() helper. Not worth a parameter object here because the flat triple is the intended per-prior JSON-summary identity; raising only as a minor observation.
channel/what_measure strings are consumed from the existing typed seam API (address.FINGERPRINT_CHANNELS / DEFAULT_WHAT_MEASURE); the harness invents no new stringly-typed domain concept.

override.repo_standard: global-crew.md: 'Match the surrounding code's naming, labeling, and in-file documentation conventions.' The fingerprint seam modules (fit.fit_driver_fingerprints ~10 args, join.join_weekend_prior) establish wide kw-only-argument signatures as the module convention.
override.reason: The harness's _prior_record/_fit_all_drivers/build_summary mirror the seam signatures they call, using kw-only separation for the same reason; matching the established seam convention subordinates the length smell here.

smells.finding: Two new isolated files; no cross-cutting edit fan-out.
ref_store.get(...).fingerprint and prior.prior.scale are one/two-hop accesses on returned values, not navigational chains (a.getB().getC().getD()).
Concretely scoped; what_measure fixed to the default; the circuits argument is a stated season-capable requirement, not speculative flexibility.
Comments carry rationale (why season-wide fit / map_version=None, why rmtree tolerates a Windows open-handle), not cover for unclear code.
